turns.reply:
A route annotated `-> "None"` (as a string) now works with `status_code=204`; the patch is submitted.

The fix is in `get_typed_return_annotation` in `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py`: an annotation equal to the string `"None"` now returns `None`, so no response model is created. Before the change, that string was evaluated into a non-`None` model and the 204 body assertion fired. A quick check with `-> "None"` and `-> None` both returned 204 and produced a 204-only OpenAPI response. I did not run the repository's test suite.
